item.title: Version 3.7.0
item.description: - **Every feature is free.** Practice exams, Past exams, the most accurate Whisper models, Insights, Reading, Library, Citations, Convert, Snippets, printing, Fix words from slides and the weekly goal no longer need a code. - **Pro is now Supporter.** If Rostrum helps you, pay what you want from $3 to keep it going. Supporters get a badge and can pick an app icon (Settings ▸ Appearance). Pro codes you already have are Supporter codes and keep working. - **Past exams:** add the old exams your professor shared, with or without a key. Rostrum reads each problem, shows what the exam tests and how often, builds a study guide around it, and writes a practice exam of the same shape, multiple choice when the original was. - **Study guides by week:** a guide can be split into parts by week, read oldest first, with titled parts you can move between. - **Courses as a table:** one layout for every term, with past terms that fold away. Terms are picked from a list, so "Summer2026" and "Summer 2026" can't split into two. - **Course details:** mark a class Online (live or self-paced, with a meeting link), set a status (Taking, Dropped, Withdrawn, Retaken), and choose from twelve distinct colors or a custom one. Schedule cards lead with the course name, not the registration number. - **Your school's grading:** set the passing grade and GPA scale in Settings, or a passing grade per course. - **Notes font:** pick the font, size and spacing for notes, including a rounded face and an extra large size; it carries into reading view, study guides, Ross and PDFs. - **Density:** Comfortable or Compact rows for courses, assignments, notes and study sources. - **Sidebar:** drag its edge to resize it or fold it down to icons. - **Links in notes:** hover to see the address; a link whose text names a different site asks before opening.
